# Google AdSense

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-agent-skills.mjs; do not edit. -->

Use `gog` for Google AdSense operations. Read `../gog/SKILL.md` first for shared auth,
output, safety, and live-write rules.

## Safe start

```bash
gog auth list --check --json --no-input
gog schema adsense --json
gog --readonly --account user@example.com adsense --help
```

- Select the account explicitly with `--account`.
- Use `--json --wrap-untrusted` for agent-readable Google content.
- Use `--readonly` when the task must not mutate Google data.
- Use `--no-input` in automation and `--dry-run` before supported writes.
- Confirm the exact account, object, and mutation before any write or delete.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `accounts` | List/get AdSense accounts |
| `adclients` | List/get ad clients |
| `adunits` | List/get ad units |
| `alerts` | List account alerts |
| `customchannels` | List/get custom channels |
| `payments` | List account payments |
| `policyissues` | List/get policy issues |
| `reports` | Generate AdSense reports |
| `sites` | List/get AdSense sites |
| `urlchannels` | List/get URL channels |

Run `gog adsense <command> --help` for flags and `gog schema adsense <command> --json`
for the machine-readable contract. Do not guess command syntax.
